statement: The actual cover [3]:E minus E[3] -> E minus {O}, with tangent v mapped to 3v, identifies the intrinsic free pro-three group N of rank10 with ker(F -> F^ab/3) for the ambient free group F of rank2. The map N/gamma4(N) -> N/(F-double-prime gamma4(N)) has actual abelian kernel Z_3^332, with saturated intrinsic graded pieces of ranks28 and304. Its quotient has graded ranks10,17,26. F-triple-prime is contained in gamma4(N), giving an exact ambient derived-length-three route. An explicit inner automorphism witnesses the kernel of the stated based automorphism comparison. The quotient maps to the actual cuspidally central group with abelian kernel Z_3^42, and its genuine outer Galois action factors continuously through the elliptic Tate image; the actual inner conjugator on the Tate kernel is computed in F-prime/F-double-prime.
where_proved: sections/E_elliptic_comparison.tex, E50.1-E50.25 and complete proof; code/a_elliptic_kernel.py/.out/.json

notes: The based geometric map is multiplication by3 and its actual tangent differential; the homology map to the ambient group is 3 times the filling map, with primitive cusp kernel T.
The basis splitting V=L+T is chosen integral coordinates, not a claimed Galois-equivariant decomposition. The map and kernel themselves are equivariant.

The group proof computes J=H gamma2(C) and J-prime=B times L3 as actual closed subgroups. B intersects gamma3(C) trivially by independent Hall coordinates; B and L3 commute. Thus the actual kernel is Z_3^28 times Z_3^304, without division by3 or inference from rational ranks.
The exact integer relation matrix has an integral right inverse onto304 discarded Hall coordinates, with coefficients0,+1,-1. The quotient lattice is therefore saturated over Z and Z_3.
The based inner-automorphism witness has domain the peripheral-conjugacy-preserving automorphism group of F. No assertion of outer non-descent for normalized genuine Galois automorphisms is inferred.

Nakamura 1995 Theorem6.6/Corollary6.7 are modulo the coefficient-abelianization ideal I_2, not the ordinary augmentation square I^2. The original full noncommutative Magnus matrix is defined in Section6.5 but is not evaluated by that congruence.
Actual higher Frobenius words remain to be evaluated; this result supplies the exact ambient-to-intrinsic maps for that work.

The full peripheral kernel I is F-prime because the ambient homology map is exactly3p and multiplication by3 is injective on the Tate module. This gives the actual quotient to N/[N,I] and its abelian kernel of graded ranks0,16,26.

On the elliptic Tate kernel the actual tangential action fixes the cusp z exactly. Writing its metabelian deviations as G_i zbar gives T2 G1=T1 G2; the regular sequence gives G_i=T_i H. Conjugation by the actual element -H zbar in F-prime/F-double-prime equals that action. It lies in N/F-double-prime, proving the stated Out quotient factorization without choosing a weight-normalized lift or asserting a splitting.

Root independently reran the complete integer Hall program and obtained identical JSON before the two additional algebraic transfers were appended. The main group and integral proof also passed root audit.
